runbooks.description: A service/unit is down or won't start — find WHY (config, port, dependency, resource), not just THAT it's down.
A web endpoint returns 5xx / connection refused — trace front proxy → app → dependency.
A filesystem is full or read-only — find what filled it and which service it broke.
A process cannot bind its port because another already holds it — identify the squatter.
An app 500s or exits because a backend (DB/cache/socket) is unreachable — local vs external.
TLS fails because a certificate is expired/invalid — check the served cert's validity.
The kernel OOM-killer or an allocation failure — find the memory hog and the victim.
A daemon won't load because its config is invalid — locate the exact offending directive.
